lines.caption: Twenty seven facilities are waiting to be onboarded.
Fifteen of them have nothing booked.
Until now that lived in a spreadsheet.
Who is going, which programs, whether they are even licensed for it.
All of it checked by hand.
So we built one screen for it.
A worklist of every facility still waiting.
And the same thing as a calendar.
An onboarding coordinator works from this and nothing else.
A visit used to carry one program.
Now it carries as many as the visit really covers.
Open a facility and the programs tick themselves.
Read straight off the facility record.
A program that facility does not run says so.
Rather than sitting there blank.
Then the question that used to take a phone call.
Who can actually go.
This facility is in Ohio, and the visit covers two programs.
Of three hundred and twenty three providers, two qualify.
They hold a current Ohio licence.
And they are approved for every program on the visit.
Not one of them. All of them.
The numbers come from the facility itself.
Census, seen, and consented.
Counted live, every time the screen opens.
So they are never stale.
Change any of this and the people on the visit hear about it.
The facilitator, and every provider going.
Move it, cancel it, or take someone off it.
An expired licence never counts.
And no patient information goes in the email.
